nodes.text:
Breaking: India detects two cases of #HMPV during routine surveillance in Karnataka.

- A 3-month-old female infant, diagnosed with HMPV, has been discharged.

- An 8-month-old male infant, who tested positive for HMPV on Jan 3, is recovering.
